procedures.title: Stall Recovery
procedures.summary: Recover promptly from an impending or fully developed aerodynamic stall.
procedures.spokenSummary: Disconnect the autopilot, reduce the angle of attack, add thrust, and level the wings.
steps: Pitch – Nose down to reduce angle of attack
Bank – Level wings using coordinated inputs
Climb – Recover to a safe airspeed before resuming climb

procedures.title: Landing Gear Down Confirmation
procedures.summary: Ensure landing gear is down and locked before landing.
procedures.spokenSummary: Select gear down and confirm three green before continuing the approach.

procedures.title: Unstable Approach Go-Around
procedures.summary: Execute a go-around when the approach is unstable or sink rate is excessive.
procedures.spokenSummary: Initiate a go-around: go-around thrust, pitch up, retract spoilers, and climb away.
steps: Pitch – 15 degrees initially, adjust to maintain climb
